r0_2_addendum.compatibility: Existing top-level fields, IDs, and meanings are retained. Consumers may ignore this additive object; no existing status is globally rewritten.

evidence_strength_vocabulary.DOCUMENT_OBSERVED: A named document, Git tree entry, commit, or blob was directly read or hashed in the stated scope; does not imply runtime behavior.
evidence_strength_vocabulary.PRIOR_TEST_REPORTED: A fixed historical report records a test/result; this work did not rerun that test.
evidence_strength_vocabulary.STATIC_INFERENCE: A bounded relationship derived from source documents without execution; inference is not proof of behavior.
evidence_strength_vocabulary.NOT_VERIFIED: The required evidence was not independently established in this work.
evidence_strength_vocabulary.BLOCKED: An explicit historical or current evidence condition remains unmet; not a PASS/READY synonym.
evidence_strength_vocabulary.OWNER_ADOPTED: An explicit Owner decision adopts limited historical knowledge only; it does not adopt v6 Requirements or authorize implementation.
